```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class CategoryFormComponent extends Component
{
    public $name;
    public $amount;
    public $description;
    public $category_id = null;
    public $id;

    public function save()
    {
        if ($this->category_id) {
            DB::table('categories')->where('id', $this->category_id)->update([
                'name' => $this->name,
                'amount' => $this->amount,
                'description' => $this->description
            ]);
        } else {
            DB::table('categories')->insert([
                'name' => $this->name,
                'amount' => $this->amount,
                'description' => $this->description
            ]);
        }
        $this->reset(['name', 'amount', 'description', 'category_id']);
    }

    public function delete()
    {
        DB::table('categories')->where('id', $this->category_id)->delete();
        $this->reset(['name', 'amount', 'description', 'category_id']);
    }
}
```
